    How this simulator works

    A rule-based parser turns your instruction into a structured action. The planner selects an object, checks its size, then animates a pick-and-place sequence.

    Supported: move / put / place / sort • red / blue / green • small / large • block / circle • left / right tray.

    Honest scope: object positions are supplied by the simulator. This is not computer vision, a trained language model, physical grasping, or collision-aware robotics. The gripper is assumed to lift above the table during transfer.
